# Accepted `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` advisories (issue 8.5).
#
# One advisory ID per line (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx, or whatever identifier
# `pnpm audit`'s JSON surfaces for it - see .github/scripts/check-audit-allowlist.py).
# Every entry MUST have a comment explaining why it's accepted (no fix
# available, not reachable from our usage, accepted risk with an owner and
# a re-review date) - never add an entry just to make CI green.
#

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Empty as of 2026-09-06 — and that is the intended state.
#
# This file previously carried twelve entries: the protobufjs advisories
# (including GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg, arbitrary code execution) plus elliptic,
# secp256k1 and uuid, all reached through wallet modules Stellar Wallets Kit
# declares as hard dependencies but this app never imports. The reasoning was
# sound and `scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs` enforced it, but "unreachable"
# is a weaker guarantee than "not present", and an allowlist that keeps
# growing is one nobody reads by the time it matters.
#
# The protobufjs entries were retired by the `protobufjs: ^7.6.1` override in
# package.json — the same technique that removed toml in #184. It dedupes the
# tree onto a patched 7.6.6 rather than arguing the vulnerable copy is
# harmless. `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` is clean with no entries here.
#
# Add an entry only when there is genuinely no fix, and give it a re-review
# date. Prefer an override; prefer removing the dependency more.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
